## Notes

The automatic findings list is empty; the issues above follow from the transcript and spec.

Read the current state.json and stock.json without changing app state. Order 6210 has status "waiting for stock", item "teapot set" and price 80 euros, matching trace.jsonl:27 and the turn 3 reply. Stock is 3 teapot sets and 12 blue mugs, matching trace.jsonl:5 and trace.jsonl:17. No reservation was requested or executed. Turn 3's stock statement has support in turn 1's result; the records show no intervening stock mutation. The test has no app-state snapshot files, so current project state is corroboration rather than a sealed historical snapshot.

The record does not establish why turn 2 took 60.981 seconds; its stock tool reports 8024 milliseconds, which does not account for the full delay.

Refunds, returns, reservations, other customers' orders and out-of-scope requests were not exercised, so this test does not establish compliance on those paths. No denied egress attempts were recorded. The app was not started or messaged during evaluation, and only this report was written.
